title: Sa Re Ga

sections.name: Listen
lines: Sa, Re, Ga, sing with me,
Ga, Re, Sa, one, two, three.
Sa, Re, Ga, the notes we know,
Ga, Re, Sa, nice and slow.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: C is Sa and D is Re,
E is Ga, hip hip hooray!
Sa, Re, Ga, the very same,

sections.name: Together
lines: Sing with me, Sa, Re, Ga,
Clap your hands, ta, ta, ta.
Sa, Re, Ga, up we climb,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Dadi sings it in the morning,
Sa, Re, Ga, the day is dawning.
Nana hums it soft and low,
Sa, Re, Ga, we love it so.

sections.name: All together
lines: Sa, Re, Ga, we're nearly done,
Ga, Re, Sa, that was fun.
Sa, Re, Ga, a little bow,
Sing it again, sing it now!

lyrics:
[Listen]
Sa, Re, Ga, sing with me,
Ga, Re, Sa, one, two, three.
Sa, Re, Ga, the notes we know,
Ga, Re, Sa, nice and slow.

[Listen again]
C is Sa and D is Re,
E is Ga, hip hip hooray!
Sa, Re, Ga, the very same,
Every note has two names.

[Together]
Sing with me, Sa, Re, Ga,
Clap your hands, ta, ta, ta.
Sa, Re, Ga, up we climb,
Ga, Re, Sa, every time.

[One more verse]
Dadi sings it in the morning,
Sa, Re, Ga, the day is dawning.
Nana hums it soft and low,
Sa, Re, Ga, we love it so.

[All together]
Sa, Re, Ga, we're nearly done,
Ga, Re, Sa, that was fun.
Sa, Re, Ga, a little bow,
Sing it again, sing it now!

title: Diwali Diya

sections.name: Listen
lines: One by one we light them all,
On the step and on the wall.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Sweets on plates, a laddoo treat,

sections.name: Together
lines: Light a diya, you and me,
Ga, Pa, Dha, and Pa, Ga, Re.
Little flames that dance and play,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: New clothes on and hugs for all,

sections.name: All together
lines: Thank you for your golden light.

lyrics:
[Listen]
Little diya, shining bright,
Diwali, festival of light.
One by one we light them all,
On the step and on the wall.

[Listen again]
Rangoli colours on the floor,
Flowers by the open door.
Sweets on plates, a laddoo treat,
Diwali, Diwali, sweet, sweet, sweet.

[Together]
Light a diya, you and me,
Ga, Pa, Dha, and Pa, Ga, Re.
Little flames that dance and play,
Happy, happy Diwali day.

[One more verse]
New clothes on and hugs for all,
Grandma, Grandpa, big and small.
Lanterns glowing in a line,
Every window starts to shine.

[All together]
Little diya, glowing bright,
Thank you for your golden light.
Diwali, Diwali, here to stay,
Happy, happy Diwali day!

title: Holi Colours

sections.name: Listen
lines: Pink and yellow, green and blue,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Water balloons go pop, pop, pop,

sections.name: Together
lines: Throw with me, a gentle throw,
Pa, Pa, Dha, and Pa, Ga, Sa,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Colour clouds up to the sky.
Hug a friend and say hello,

sections.name: All together
lines: Wash it off, the colours go,
Pink and green and blue below.

lyrics:
[Listen]
Pink and yellow, green and blue,
Holi colours, just for you!
Splash, splash, a colour shower,
Every face a happy flower.

[Listen again]
Water balloons go pop, pop, pop,
Run and giggle, never stop.
Friends and family, all around,
Colours dancing on the ground.

[Together]
Throw with me, a gentle throw,
Colours, colours, high and low.
Pa, Pa, Dha, and Pa, Ga, Sa,
Holi, Holi, ha, ha, ha!

[One more verse]
Gujiya sweets and cool thandai,
Colour clouds up to the sky.
Hug a friend and say hello,
Happy Holi, off we go!

[All together]
Wash it off, the colours go,
Pink and green and blue below.
Holi, Holi, what a day,
Happy Holi, hip hooray!

title: Garba Round

styles: spinning in a circle, Gujarati garba feel

lyrics:
[Listen]
Round and round,
Garba sound.
Clap and spin,
Join in!

[Listen again]
Dandiya sticks,
Click, click, click.
Step to the side,
Swing wide.

[Together]
Dance with me,
One, two, three.
Round we go,
Fast and slow.

[One more verse]
Colours swirl,
Twirl, twirl, twirl.
Lights so bright,
Navratri night.

[All together]
Round once more,
Round the floor.
Clap, clap, done,
What fun!

title: Patang Up High

sections.name: Listen
lines: Red kite dancing in the sky.
Pull the string and let it fly,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Up on the roof, the wind is here,
Blue and orange, green and gold,
Hold the string and hold, hold, hold.

sections.name: Together
lines: Fly with me, my kite and you,
Sa, Ga, Pa, and Dha too.
Flying kites is so much fun.

sections.name: All together
lines: Patang comes down, the sun sets low,
Wind is resting, time to go.
See you next year in the sky.

lyrics:
[Listen]
Patang, patang, up so high,
Red kite dancing in the sky.
Pull the string and let it fly,
Patang, patang, wave goodbye.

[Listen again]
Up on the roof, the wind is here,
Kites of every colour near.
Blue and orange, green and gold,
Hold the string and hold, hold, hold.

[Together]
Fly with me, my kite and you,
Sa, Ga, Pa, and Dha too.
Higher, higher, to the sun,
Flying kites is so much fun.

[One more verse]
Til laddoo and chikki sweet,
Rooftop picnic, what a treat.
Neighbours shouting, kai po che,
Happy kite day, hip hooray!

[All together]
Patang comes down, the sun sets low,
Wind is resting, time to go.
Patang, patang, up so high,
See you next year in the sky.

title: Rakhi Thread

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Brother says, I'll keep you safe,
Sweets to share, a little hug,

sections.name: Together
lines: Tie with me a Rakhi bow,
Sa, Re, Ga, nice and slow.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Cousins come from near and far,

sections.name: All together
lines: Love to keep and love to hold.
Rakhi day, our joy and pride.

lyrics:
[Listen]
Little thread, red and gold,
Tie it round, hold, hold.
Sister, brother, side by side,
Rakhi day, arms open wide.

[Listen again]
Brother says, I'll keep you safe,
Sister smiles a happy face.
Sweets to share, a little hug,
Rakhi thread, warm and snug.

[Together]
Tie with me a Rakhi bow,
Sa, Re, Ga, nice and slow.
Family love, round and round,
Rakhi thread, safe and sound.

[One more verse]
Cousins come from near and far,
Every one a shining star.
Rakhi, rakhi, on each hand,
Biggest family in the land.

[All together]
Little thread, red and gold,
Love to keep and love to hold.
Sister, brother, side by side,
Rakhi day, our joy and pride.

title: At the Mela

sections.name: Listen
lines: Come to the mela, come and see,
Giant wheel goes round with me.
Balloons and bangles, bells that ring,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Candy floss so pink and sweet,
Catch the fun now if you can.

sections.name: Together
lines: Up and down and round and round.
Pa, Dha, Pa, and Ga, Pa, Sa,
At the mela, ha, ha, ha!

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Toy flute, toy drum, a spinning top,
Clap your hands and stamp your feet,

sections.name: All together
lines: Sleepy on the way back home.

lyrics:
[Listen]
Come to the mela, come and see,
Giant wheel goes round with me.
Balloons and bangles, bells that ring,
At the mela, everything!

[Listen again]
Candy floss so pink and sweet,
Hot jalebi, what a treat.
Puppet show and magic man,
Catch the fun now if you can.

[Together]
Ride with me the merry-go-round,
Up and down and round and round.
Pa, Dha, Pa, and Ga, Pa, Sa,
At the mela, ha, ha, ha!

[One more verse]
Toy flute, toy drum, a spinning top,
Mela, mela, never stop.
Clap your hands and stamp your feet,
Music playing in the street.

[All together]
Goodbye, mela, time for home,
Sleepy on the way back home.
Come again another day,
Mela, mela, hip hooray!

title: Harvest Day

sections.name: Listen
lines: Golden fields of rice and wheat,
Harvest time, the sun is sweet.
Farmers sing and cows go moo,
Thank you, earth, we thank you too.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Pot that bubbles, smells so nice.
Harvest songs for me and you.

sections.name: Together
lines: Sing with me the harvest song,
Sa, Re, Ga, Pa, all day long.
Fill the baskets, one by one,
Thank you, rain, and thank you, sun.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Sparks go flying to the sky.
Drums go dum and feet go tap,

sections.name: All together
lines: Golden fields go off to sleep,
Seeds to plant and seeds to keep.
Thank you, earth, for all you grow,
Harvest day, we love you so.

lyrics:
[Listen]
Golden fields of rice and wheat,
Harvest time, the sun is sweet.
Farmers sing and cows go moo,
Thank you, earth, we thank you too.

[Listen again]
Sugarcane and fresh new rice,
Pot that bubbles, smells so nice.
Pongal, Lohri, Bihu, too,
Harvest songs for me and you.

[Together]
Sing with me the harvest song,
Sa, Re, Ga, Pa, all day long.
Fill the baskets, one by one,
Thank you, rain, and thank you, sun.

[One more verse]
Bonfire bright and dancing high,
Sparks go flying to the sky.
Drums go dum and feet go tap,
Harvest night, clap, clap, clap.

[All together]
Golden fields go off to sleep,
Seeds to plant and seeds to keep.
Thank you, earth, for all you grow,
Harvest day, we love you so.

title: Dhol Baje

styles: joyful dhol-like drums, not too loud

sections.name: Together
lines: Dance with me, dum, dum, dum,
Sa, Sa, Pa, and Pa, Dha, hum.
Hands up high and turn around,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Dhol baje, dum, dum, dum,
Here the happy dancers come.
Every festival, every day,
Dhol baje, let's all play!

[Listen again]
Diwali lights and Holi hues,
Garba spins and kite-day news.
Rakhi, mela, harvest too,
Dhol baje, me and you!

[Together]
Dance with me, dum, dum, dum,
Sa, Sa, Pa, and Pa, Dha, hum.
Hands up high and turn around,
Dhol baje, what a sound!

[One more verse]
Nani, Dadi, join the beat,
Uncles tapping with their feet.
Little cousins, big and small,
Dhol baje, one and all.

[All together]
Dhol baje, last time now,
Everybody, take a bow.
Every festival, every day,
Dhol baje, hip hooray!
